name: LINK CLICK
description: Using superpowers to enter their clientele’s photos one by one, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang take their work seriously at “Time Photo Studio,” a small photography shop set in the backdrop of a modern metropolis. Each job can be full of danger, but nothing is more important than fulfilling every order, no matter the scale…or peril involved!

videos.title: Marrying by Contesting
videos.overview: In order to marry Ouyang, the daughter of the master of martial arts, Siwen commissioned the Time Photo Studio to help him crack the master's unique martial arts.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 1: Turn on Cycle Mode
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi has started humming a song he got stuck in his head, and Lu Guang loses sleep because of it.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 2: About Ordering Takeout
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang struggle to decide what kind of food to order.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 3: New Addition to Photo Gallery
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finds a cat and tries to add it as the newest member of the Time Photo Studio.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 4: About Companionship
videos.overview: The trio come up with names for their new cat.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 5: The Mystery of the Witch
videos.overview: Qiao Ling gives Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang a tarot card reading.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 6: New Business for Photo Studios
videos.overview: The Time Photo Studio is struggling to make money so Cheng Xiaoshi comes up with a new idea to help the business grow.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 7: Live Q&A with Trio
videos.overview: The Trio host a Q&A live stream and answer fan questions.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 8: The Martial Arts Routine of the Trio
videos.overview: Liu Siwen teaches the trio some martial arts moves.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 9: Qiao Ling's Troubles
videos.overview: Qiao Ling seems unhappy lately, so Cheng Xiaoshi tries to figure out why.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 10: Time Connection
videos.overview: A music student hires the the Time Photo Studio to help find a lost part of a music score.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 11: Trio's Martial Arts Diary
videos.overview: Liu Siwen teaches the trio how to do stretches and splits at the dojo.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 12: Mid-autumn Full Moon
videos.overview: A mooncake shopkeeper hires the Time Photo Studio to deliver a message to his mother.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 13: Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Qiao Ling prepare a surprise birthday party for Lu Guang.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 14: Halloween Horror
videos.overview: Lu Guang gets frightened on Halloween night.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 15: About Computer Repair
videos.overview: Lu Guang struggles to figure out why his laptop has suddenly stopped working.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 16: The Second Round of Live Q&A!
videos.overview: The trio host another Q&A live stream and answer more fan questions, with a surprise mystery box.

videos.title: The Daily Life in Lighttime Short Episode 17: Time Connection, The Second Commission!
videos.overview: Qiao Ling entrusts a new task to Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang about a young girl who forgot something important.

videos.title: The Daily Life of Lighttime Short Episode 18: Final Words An Unexpected Visitor
videos.overview: A very special guest visits the Time Photo Studio.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 1 - Rehabilitation Training
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi is bored While recovering from an injury, so he has Lu Guang and Qiao Ling take care of his needs.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 2 - In Dreams and In Reality
videos.overview: Lu Guang has a series of dreams while taking care of Cheng Xiaoshi.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 3 -  A Leisurely Day
videos.overview: Liu Xiao is invited to Xia Fei's graduation ceremony. Vein tags along undercover, but not before giving Liu Xiao's pet owl some extra treats.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 4 - Party A and Party B
videos.overview: Xia Fei reluctantly visits Liu Xiao after receiving a strange part-time job offer.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 5 -  The Occult Girl
videos.overview: Qiao Ling figures out a new way to bring in new customers to the Time Photo Studio by using tarot cards.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 6 -  Surprise Live Stream
videos.overview: Xia Fei hosts a special unboxing event livestream for some collaboration blind boxes.

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 7 - Distinguished Guest
videos.overview: Li Haoling returns to the Time Photo Studio to answer some questions about the upcoming third season of "Time Angst-Man".

videos.title: Mini Link Click Episode 8 - The Hour Hand Flees
videos.overview: Qiao Ling gathers everyone to prepare for the annual anniversary music project, "Dream Out!".

videos.title: Emma
videos.overview: In order to obtain evidence of falsified financial reports, Cheng Xiaoshi entered the world of photos taken by Emma, an employee of VIcky Games, under the command of Lu Guang.

videos.title: Secret Recipe
videos.overview: Yuxia, owner of a chain restaurant company finds the timing duo hoping to obtain the secret soup recipe secretly kept by partner Lin Zhen.

videos.title: To Lose, Not To Win
videos.overview: Cheng Xiao entered the photo with the regret of his client when he was young, and played a special basketball game.

videos.title: Confess
videos.overview: The commission went on smoothly, but Cheng Xiaoshi gradually realized that this mission was directed towards an unspeakable memory.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: Facing the irreversible past, Cheng Xiaoshi wanted to change their future.

videos.title: Search of the Child
videos.overview: Police Xiao Li came to the door and commissioned it, hoping to use the capabilities of Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang to investigate a child abduction case.

videos.title: Aunt May
videos.overview: Doudou's whereabouts are at a loss, but Cheng Xiaoshi's persistence brought a turn for the case.

videos.title: Lost Signal
videos.overview: In addition to solving emotional problems for Qiao Ling's friend Xu Shanshan, Time Photo Studio received an "unexpected joy".

videos.title: Consequence of Goodwill
videos.overview: Xu Shanshan's disappearance was not simple. At the same time, Lu Guang discovered unexpected clues from the photos.

videos.title: Trap
videos.overview: To protect Xu Shanshan's safety, Cheng Xiaoshi made a "deal" with the murderer.

videos.title: Pinnacle of Light
videos.overview: The serial murderer was finally arrested, but the battle for Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang was not over yet.

videos.title: Falling
videos.overview: After the incident with Lu Guang, Cheng is forced to deal with the devastating situation and is forced to pay the debt as things begin to uncover.

videos.title: Night Raid
videos.overview: Cheng and Qiao Ling need to fight to solve the situation, while Inspector Xiao Li attends Inspector Chen Bin.

videos.title: Two Funerals
videos.overview: Cheng and Qiao encounter a familiar face that comes to their aid. However, they later find themselves at a funeral.

videos.title: Them In The Photo
videos.overview: Qian Jin continues to look for Liu Min's phone while Lu Guang and Cheng investigate the photo that was given to Lu Guang.

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: Cheng and Lu Guang continue to investigate the photo but in doing so, they uncover the dark past that hid within the picture.

videos.title: Li Tianxi
videos.overview: Cheng begins to interrogate Li Tianxi unknowing of her intentions, in doing so, the police and the others stress, as things take a confusing turn.

videos.title: Urban Warfare
videos.overview: As Li Tianxi and Cheng continue their ulterior motive, inspectors Xiao Li and Wang Juan indulge in a physical and psychological battle in hopes to expose their intentions.

videos.title: Hostage
videos.overview: With Lu Guangs sudden interference Cheng and Qiao are left perplexed and saved, however, things take a sharp turn ruining the situation even more.

videos.title: Three Stories
videos.overview: As Cheng continues his mission in the past, Li Tianchen and Qian Jin's backstories uncover, revealing their true natures.

videos.title: Improvise
videos.overview: After learning the secrets to Li Tianchen's powers, Cheng comes up with a strategy to try and save Lu Guang but things don't end up going as planned.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: Cheng comes up with a tactical strategy to try and save both himself and Lu Guang, however Qian Jing proves that he is one step ahead and things end up going unexpectedly for both sides.

videos.title: Can't Live Without a Good Brother
videos.overview: There are rules, and they must be followed. What is the price to pay when one of them is broken?

videos.title: So Time Begins to Flow Again
videos.overview: Lu Guang goes back in time to where it all began.

videos.title: Prelude
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finds a photograph of the city of Bridon, apparently sent by his father. At the same time, a series of scams taking place in the same locality are making headlines in the news. Knowing him, he will not hesitate to go to Lu Guang to uncover the mystery.

videos.title: Them
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang arrive in Bridon in search of clues to solve the mystery of Cheng Xiaoshi's father. When they reach the airport, problems immediately arise for them…

videos.title: And Then There Were None
videos.overview: The mysterious boss of Xia Fei comes to the boys' rescue, but after the first exchange of words, Lu Guang notices that something isn't right.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: After witnessing the academy fire, Cheng Xiaoshi understands his power thanks to Lu Guang, and they try to find out who survived the disaster.

videos.title: Puzzle
videos.overview: Cheng Xiaoshi finally manages to talk to Vein, but to help him, Vein demands that he and Lu Guang help him replace a fired model.

language: Mandarin, Chinese, Japanese, English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic
